A translate call whose params differ from the placeholders of the source message.

The check is on by default, with the severity `warning`.

The check compares the params a translate call passes with the placeholders of the source message. For `"greet": "Hello {{name}}"`, it reports `t('greet', { nam })`: `name` is missing and `nam` is unused.

It needs a preset that tells where the params of a call are; the i18next presets do. Options the library reads itself, such as i18next `count`, `context` and `defaultValue`, are never unused. Unused params are reported only when the message has placeholders and no nested messages (`$t(key)`), which may use them.

The check skips a call whose params it cannot read, such as a variable or a spread (`t('greet', opts)`), and a key whose source message is not a string, such as a plural key that only has `greet_one` and `greet_other`.

## Configure

Change the severity, or turn the check off, in `checks`:

```ts [x18n.config.ts]
import { defineConfig } from '@x18n/core'

export default defineConfig({
  checks: {
    'param-mismatch': 'off',
  },
})
```

`x18n check --only param-mismatch` runs this check alone. `x18n check --skip param-mismatch` skips it for one run.
